#include <iostream>
#include <string>

int countEvenRuns(const std::string& s, size_t i, size_t start) {
    if (i == s.length()) {
        return ((i - start) % 2 == 0) ? 1 : 0;
    }
    if (s[i] != s[start]) {
        int add = ((i - start) % 2 == 0) ? 1 : 0;
        return add + countEvenRuns(s, i, i);
    }
    return countEvenRuns(s, i + 1, start);
}

int main() {
    std::string str;
    std::getline(std::cin, str);
    if (str.empty()) {
        std::cout << 0 << std::endl;
        return 0;
    }
    std::cout << countEvenRuns(str, 1, 0) << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
